row.evidence: Duo's generic inbound SCIM guide says "The Directory Sync feature is part of the Duo Premier, Duo Advantage, and Duo Essentials plans", and the pricing page lists Duo Directory in Essentials at $3 per user/month, the cheapest paid tier.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: free (No Tax). Inbound SCIM 2.0 (generic and Okta) plus vendor-run directory sync from Entra ID, Google Workspace, AD and OpenLDAP are part of Essentials ($3), Advantage ($6) and Premier ($9); Duo Free (up to 10 users) has no directory sync. Duo is itself an IdP; SCIM here is inbound provisioning of Duo users from an external directory. The SCIM bearer token expires every 90 days. duo.com/pricing now redirects to duo.com/editions-and-pricing. Admin API (users, groups, admins, logs) is on all paid plans.

plans.name: Duo Free
plans.notes: Free lists MFA, integrations and the authenticator app only; Admin API and directory sync are documented for paid plans.

auth.token_source: Duo Admin Panel > Users > External Directories > Add External Directory > Generic Inbound > Complete Setup > API Credentials
auth.notes: Owners get an 'Action required' email starting 15 days before expiry; regenerate the token and paste it into the IdP. Base URL does not change.

endpoints.notes: Inferred from users and groups provisioning; Duo publishes no SCIM endpoint reference.

operations.notes: Deactivation is described as 'typically a PATCH with active: false'. Okta app supports Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push.

deprovision.data_retained: User stays in Duo with status Disabled and becomes unmanaged and editable; a SCIM DELETE sends the user to the Trash (Pending Deletion), permanently deleted after seven days unless restored.

custom.how: In the SCIM integration's Attribute Mapping, '+ Add mapping' imports additional SCIM attributes and can map them to new custom Duo user attributes.

attributes.notes: Required defaults: userName -> Username, email -> Email Address, givenName -> First Name, familyName -> Last Name (Okta guide). The full list of optional SCIM attributes is shown only in the Admin Panel.

roles.how: SCIM provisioning does not import or manage Duo administrators; group-based policies apply to SCIM-managed groups.

limitations.text: SCIM cannot import or manage Duo administrators (admin sync is available only via AD, Entra ID, Google or OpenLDAP directory sync).
Bearer token expires every 90 days and must be regenerated.
Synced attributes (username, display name, email, phones, group memberships) cannot be edited in Duo via Admin Panel, Admin API or CSV import.
Changing a user's status in the directory does not update Duo unless the IdP sends an explicit SCIM request such as PATCH active: false.

auth.notes: Integration key + secret key; each request signed with HMAC-SHA512 and sent with HTTP Basic auth. Permissions are set per Admin API application.

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate via POST /admin/v1/users/[user_id] status 'disabled'/'active' (not allowed for AD or Entra-synced users). Roles apply to administrators via /admin/v1/admins. invite_user = POST /admin/v1/users/enroll.

endpoints.purpose: Sync one user from a directory

rate_limits.text: Bulk create and bulk restore: max 100 users per request at 50 calls per minute; other calls return 429 when too many requests are made.

limitations.text: The 'disabled' status cannot be set via Admin API for users managed by Active Directory or Entra ID sync.

okta.notes: OIN 'Duo Security SCIM Provisioning' marks SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked (read from page markup); SAML not checked. Duo's own guide uses it. An Aquera connector is also listed in OIN.

entra.notes: Duo-run Entra ID sync imports users and administrators without on-prem software. Entra gallery SCIM app not checked.

onelogin.notes: No Duo OneLogin guide; Duo's generic inbound SCIM works with any directory with outbound SCIM. OneLogin catalogue not checked (bot-blocked).

jumpcloud.notes: Not checked; generic inbound SCIM would apply.

fallbacks.other_sync: Duo-run directory sync from Active Directory and OpenLDAP (via Duo Authentication Proxy), Entra ID and Google Workspace

Docs do not say whether disabled SCIM users still count toward the licensed user count.
Whether the pricing page prices are annual or monthly is not stated.
Entra gallery listing for Duo provisioning not checked; Duo documents its own Entra ID sync instead.
